name: event-calendar
description: Events with dates, venue and ticket link: upcoming and past lists for the page builder, an iCal feed and Event structured data.

schema_slug.title: Event content type

time_zone.description: IANA name of the zone the stored event times are in and the zone dates are shown in, for example Europe/London. An unknown name means UTC.
